query: Compare evals/fixtures/figma.json with evals/fixtures/code.css and tell me what drifted. Figma is the source of truth.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/sync.js diff instead of comparing by eye
Reports color/primary mismatch (#1d4ed8 vs #2563eb) and does not report color/brand separately (alias to the same token)
Reports --legacy as missing in Figma and color/accent vs --brand-blue as a possible rename, asking which name wins
Does not change any file before the person approves

query: Apply the Figma values to code.css for the mismatches, I approve the primary color and the missing dark accent.
expected_behavior: Sets approve true only for those two entries in changes.json
Runs apply --dry then apply and reports how many were applied
Re-runs diff and reports the remaining 2 differences as chosen to keep

query: Sync my Tailwind config theme.extend colors with Figma.
expected_behavior: Says Tailwind v3 JS theme objects are not supported by the script
Asks for an export to CSS custom properties or W3C JSON, or writes the values to a temporary JSON file in W3C shape
Does not invent token values it was not given
